name: kube-noob-skills
description: Kubernetes, OpenShift, ROSA HCP, Helm and RHACS skills that run the kube-noob CLI you install yourself: audit and validate manifests, diagnose pasted events and logs, explain policy denials, check NetworkPolicy reachability, find reported OpenShift issues and grade exercises, offline. Each skill first checks that kube-noob is installed and says so when it is not, instead of guessing. The plugin is Markdown only: no MCP server, no script, no code.
